items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: He used to say to us that invariably all the weird and weirdest characters would seek him out... 'which one of ‘em is Dukey Wellington?'

ctx.x: And they talked and everything, turned that charm back on her you know. He was a monster boy.

He used to have another saying that I crack up every time I think about it. He used to say to us that invariably all the weird and weirdest characters would seek him out, would always come, so you’d see strange people coming around the bandstand, coming up saying “hi there, which one of ‘em is Dukey Wellington?” And, “what’s the piano player’s name?” You know they would always seek him out, so he would always say, “they come from miles around and they seek me out.” And every time one of those situations was about…
Basie had his little thing too.
